// This file is copied only to a disposable, network-isolated scratch checkout.
import 'dart:async';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:my_web_app/pages/asset_management_page.dart';
import 'package:my_web_app/services/asset_liability_planning_service.dart';
import 'package:my_web_app/services/asset_liability_repository.dart';
import 'package:supabase_flutter/supabase_flutter.dart';
import 'asset_debt_read_contract.dart';

const _owner = 'synthetic-owner';
const _token = 'synthetic-token';
const _debtName = 'Synthetic Loan';
final _date = DateTime(2026, 10, 14);
const _snapshot = <String, double>{_debtName: -10000};

class _LocalRepository extends SharedPreferencesAssetLiabilityRepository {
  _LocalRepository(this.initial);
  final Map<String, int> initial;
  final saves = <Map<String, int>>[];
  @override
  Future<Map<String, int>> loadDebtPaymentDayOverrides() async => Map.of(initial);
  @override
  Future<void> saveDebtPaymentDayOverrides(Map<String, int> value) async {
    saves.add(Map<String, int>.of(value));
  }
}

class _Transport {
  _Transport(this.scenario, this.id);
  final DebtReadScenario scenario;
  final String id;
  final owners = <String>[];
  final writes = <Map<String, int>>[];
  final started = Completer<void>();
  final release = Completer<void>();
  int errorsEmitted = 0;
  Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> read(String owner) async {
    owners.add(owner);
    if (!started.isCompleted) started.complete();
    await release.future;
    if (scenario == DebtReadScenario.failed) {
      errorsEmitted++;
      throw StateError('synthetic read failure');
    } else if (scenario == DebtReadScenario.missing) {
      return <Map<String, dynamic>>[];
    } else {
      return <Map<String, dynamic>>[
      <String, dynamic>{
        'user_id': _owner,
        'pref_key': 'debt_payment_day_overrides',
        'value': <String, int>{id: 17},
        'updated_at': null,
      },
      ];
    }
  }
  void respond() => release.complete();
  Future<void> write(Map<String, int> value) async {
    writes.add(Map<String, int>.of(value));
  }
}

Session _session() => Session(
  accessToken: _token,
  tokenType: 'bearer',
  user: User(id: _owner, appMetadata: const {}, userMetadata: const {},
      aud: 'authenticated', createdAt: '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z'),
);


DebtReadHarness makeDebtReadHarness(DebtReadScenario scenario) => _Harness(scenario);

class _Harness implements DebtReadHarness {
  _Harness(this.scenario) {
    final workbook = const AssetLiabilityPlanningService().buildWorkbook(
      latestSnapshot: _snapshot, baseDate: _date,
    );
    id = workbook.debtMasterRows.singleWhere((r) => r.name == _debtName).id;
    transport = _Transport(scenario, id);
    repository = _LocalRepository(scenario == DebtReadScenario.existing
      ? <String, int>{} : <String, int>{id: 10});
  }
  final DebtReadScenario scenario;
  @override
  late final String id;
  late final _Transport transport;
  late final _LocalRepository repository;
  final key = GlobalKey();
  dynamic get _state {
    final value = key.currentState;
    if (value == null) throw StateError('page not mounted');
    return value;
  }
  @override
  Widget root() => MaterialApp(home: AssetManagementPage(
    key: key, debugNow: _date, debugCalendarNow: _date,
    debugInitialAssetData: <String, Map<String, double>>{'2026-10-14': _snapshot},
    assetLiabilityRepository: repository, debugMirrorReadsAuthoritative: true,
    debugDebtRead: transport.read, debugDebtWrite: transport.write,
    debugDebtOwner: () => _owner, debugDebtToken: () => _token,
    debugDebtAuthEvents: Stream<AuthState>.value(AuthState(AuthChangeEvent.signedIn, _session())),
  ));
  @override
  Future<void> get readStarted => transport.started.future;
  @override
  void respond() => transport.respond();
  @override
  Future<void> waitRestore() => _state.debugWaitDebtAutoRestoreForTest() as Future<void>;
  @override
  Future<void> waitBackfills() => _state.debugWaitDebtBackfillsForTest() as Future<void>;
  @override
  Future<void> waitSaves() => _state.debugWaitDebtSavesForTest() as Future<void>;
  @override
  Future<void> waitWrites() => _state.debugWaitDebtWritesForTest() as Future<void>;
  @override
  List<String> get owners => transport.owners;
  @override
  List<Map<String, int>> get writes => transport.writes;
  @override
  List<Map<String, int>> get saves => repository.saves;
  @override
  int get errorsEmitted => transport.errorsEmitted;
}
